title: Long-Route Surcharge on Northgate Delivery & Installation Reschedule Fees
content:
A long-route surcharge is added to the reschedule fee of each move that owes a fee on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, according to the road miles that the appointment's extended-distance entry carries as its units:

- 20 or more miles add $20.00;
- fewer than 20 miles add $8.00;
- an appointment with no extended-distance entry adds nothing.

The miles are the units on the appointment's extended-distance entry in its fee history.

## Examples (hypothetical entries)

| Units on the extended-distance entry | Surcharge added to each owed move |
|---|---|
| 35 | $20.00 |
| 20 | $20.00 |
| 19 | $8.00 |
| 4 | $8.00 |
| No extended-distance entry on the appointment | Nothing |

An appointment with two moves owing a fee and an extended-distance entry of 22 miles carries $20.00 on each of the two moves.
